purpose: Final 1920x1080+ WebP art direction for the eight Episode 01 immersive environments. Characters and gameplay props remain separate runtime layers.

global_contract.style: commercial adult-friendly 2.5D casual-strategy construction drama; grounded Korean construction-site realism with clean readable silhouettes and restrained cinematic lighting
global_contract.continuity: same fictional NEW PSI universe with NEW PSI CONSTRUCTION as contractor and NEW PSI ZERO SITE 01 as site identity; no other real company logos, real site names, apartment brands, readable license plates or copyrighted signage
global_contract.composition: 16:9 landscape; preserve clean lower-center dialogue/readability zone and avoid critical hazards at extreme crop edges; support desktop cover crop and mobile 16:9 crop
global_contract.character_rule: do not bake named cast into background; distant anonymous workers may appear only as scale silhouettes
global_contract.prop_rule: do not make the runtime focal prop the only readable story cue; leave room for overlay props/characters
global_contract.detail: accurate PPE, temporary works, access routes, materials, vehicles and Korean-site spatial logic; avoid generic Western industrial-site visual language
reject: real corporate branding or identifiable real-project signage; only fictional NEW PSI identity may be readable
baked dialogue text, UI, captions or watermarks
global_contract.branding: When a company/site identity must be visible, use NEW PSI / NEW PSI CONSTRUCTION. When text is not needed, leave the surface unbranded rather than using anonymous placeholders.

gate_dawn.story_function: Arrival and next-day reset. The site feels active before the player understands its social rules.
gate_dawn.time_light: 06:20–06:55 blue dawn shifting to warm work lights; moist cool air, low sun not yet dominant
gate_dawn.camera: eye-level wide 28–32mm equivalent from just outside/inside gate, slight diagonal into site
must_show: worker entry path separated imperfectly from vehicle flow
idling work vehicles or delivery queue
temporary fencing and safety signage; any readable company mark uses NEW PSI only
gate_dawn.tension: busy but not dangerous on its face; subtle competition for space and attention
gate_dawn.ui_safe_zone: lower center 38% relatively low-detail; main visual anchors upper-left and mid-right

ramp_entry.story_function: Schedule collision and Junho signal. The player can see why material flow, vehicle access and people interfere with each other.
ramp_entry.time_light: early morning neutral-cool daylight with warmer reflected construction lighting
ramp_entry.camera: wide-to-medium 30–35mm equivalent looking along a temporary ramp/entry lane
must_show: temporary ramp or constrained entry lane
material staging encroaching on movement space
barriers/cones that are present but imperfectly resolve flow
ramp_entry.tension: credible congestion, not a crash scene
ramp_entry.ui_safe_zone: lower center-left reserved; strongest depth line should lead toward right-center

work_yard.story_function: Field command, TBM gap, restart pressure and instruction cascade. Formal controls coexist with changing work.
work_yard.time_light: morning daylight, slightly dusty/overcast, realistic temporary illumination under structure
work_yard.camera: wide 28–32mm equivalent at worker eye height across active staging/workface
must_show: space for later overlay of harness/open-edge/access props
work_yard.tension: work is moving; control measures can lag behind sequence changes
work_yard.ui_safe_zone: lower 35% center uncluttered enough for dialogue; avoid a giant central machine

concrete_pour.story_function: Pump arrival and first pour set piece. Production energy is high and spatial control matters.
concrete_pour.time_light: brighter morning daylight with wet concrete/rebar reflections; no dramatic storm
concrete_pour.camera: dynamic wide 26–30mm equivalent, pump/truck mass on right side and workface depth left/center
must_show: concrete pump truck/boom context without a real manufacturer brand; optional NEW PSI site decal only
hose/pour work area or slab/rebar context
workers as small distant scale silhouettes only
concrete_pour.tension: energetic productive scene with limited maneuvering room; no collision frozen in progress
concrete_pour.ui_safe_zone: lower center kept readable; boom/vehicle silhouette concentrated upper/right

inspection_zone.story_function: Inspection discovery, pushback and reinspection. The same place must support both hazard evidence and corrective-control reading.
inspection_zone.time_light: midday neutral daylight; slightly cool concrete interior/exterior transition
inspection_zone.camera: medium-wide 32–38mm equivalent aimed across edge/access zone with clear depth references
must_show: clear physical reference points that can look changed on reinspection
inspection_zone.tension: ambiguous enough that sequencing and adequacy of controls must be judged, not visually pre-decided
inspection_zone.ui_safe_zone: center-lower clean; inspection clues left and right so choice focus can crop either way

site_office.story_function: Responsibility clash, report return and record pressure. Human accounts meet incomplete records.
site_office.time_light: daytime site office, cool fluorescent/LED light with warm daylight leak from window
site_office.camera: medium-wide 35–40mm equivalent from meeting-table corner toward wall/window
must_show: window hinting at active site outside
blank/abstract pinboard or document wall for runtime evidence-board overlay
site_office.tension: administrative pressure and field proximity, not a corporate boardroom
site_office.ui_safe_zone: right-upper/center room for evidence-board layer; lower center not busy

break_area.story_function: Stop-work social aftershock. Safety action has interpersonal and cultural consequences after the immediate hazard is gone.
break_area.time_light: late afternoon soft light, sheltered break/rest area
break_area.camera: medium-wide 35mm equivalent with benches/table and worksite glimpsed beyond
must_show: space where small groups could plausibly talk apart from each other
break_area.tension: social distance and fatigue, not hostility staged like a confrontation poster
break_area.ui_safe_zone: center-lower clear; seating and site glimpse toward sides

home_night.story_function: Evening reflection. Work traces remain mentally present without melodramatic punishment or reward.
home_night.time_light: quiet Korean apartment-like night, warm practical lamp plus cool window city light
home_night.camera: medium-wide 35–40mm equivalent from seated eye level toward modest living/dining workspace
must_show: small table/desk usable for notes or study
window with distant urban traffic lights
visual calm distinct from site scenes
home_night.tension: decompression with residual cognitive load; neither bleak nor triumphal
home_night.ui_safe_zone: lower center and left readable; memory-strip can occupy upper/right
